subject: maths
title: Count and Add

teach.text: Today, you will get to do math in different ways. How many objects are in your collection? Can you prove it to me? Now we are going to learn a game called Number Race, Add to 10. Let’s play a round together. I am going to roll both dot cubes and find the total number of dots. How many dots are there? How do you know?
